item.summary: Indian visitors to the UAE and Singapore can now book experiences seamlessly with UPI. Indian visitors planning travel to two of the world’s premier destinations can now seamlessly book experiences and make online payments using their preferred Unified Payments Interface (UPI) apps. This development marks a significant step in enabling easier, currency-friction-free planning for Indian…
item.title: UPI Acceptance Enabled for Online Bookings at At the Top, Burj Khalifa and Resorts World Sentosa
